text: マヨは　わしに　にて　かわいいから　あぶないめに　あってたら……！

structure.jp: マヨは　わしに　にて
あぶないめに　あってたら……！
structure.en: if she has run into danger...!

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what follows. かわいいから = 'because she is cute'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら means 'if'. あってたら is the short spoken form of あっていたら, and the sentence breaks off in worry. あぶないめにあってたら = 'if she has met with something dangerous'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins 'resembles me' to the next part, giving the feel of 'and so'. わしににて = 'taking after me'.
